description: This file defines a custom exception class 'APIAuthenticationException' used within the OpenMRS API for handling authentication-related errors, extending from a base 'APIException'. It provides multiple constructors to include different context information about the authentication failure.

classes.name: APIAuthenticationException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating an authentication failure within the OpenMRS API, often related to user privileges.

methods.name: APIAuthenticationException()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an exception without specific message or cause.

methods.name: APIAuthenticationException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message describing the authentication failure context.

methods.name: APIAuthenticationException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message and the underlying cause of the failure.

methods.name: APIAuthenticationException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a cause of the failure.
